//: globalEnv: NODE_ENV gates dev-only code paths (validation warnings in CircularProgress, the missing-provider warning in getDialog, the nodeEnv export in lib/env), so it changes what a build emits. Left out of the cache key, a production build can be served the development output. NEXT_PUBLIC_* is a wildcard on purpose: every such var in this workspace is substituted at BUILD time (API origin, STATIC_BUILD which moves basePath, keys), so each belongs in the key — and a named list would silently miss the next one added. CI gates build behaviour in config/utils/env.ts. — Typechecking answers to two names: packages/* and apps/* define `check`, widgets/* define `check-types`. Both are declared so a root run covers all 30 members. A task turbo declares but nobody defines runs zero tasks and still exits 0; `type-check` was exactly that (0 of 30 members defined it) and was removed rather than left looking like a gate.
